paite: Tuipi gamdai puakgik. Sim gam a pingpei apaisuak bang in gamdai a kipan in, gam lauhuaipi a kipan in ahong hi.
heading: Babulon Pukna Mengmuhna
english: The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the South sweep through, it comes from the wilderness, from an awesome land.

paite: Kilakna thu khauhtak ka kiang ah theihsak ahita; lepchiahtak a hihmi in lepchiahtak in ahih a, lokmi in alok hi. Elamte aw, paitou un, Mediate aw, umbichilh un; athumna tengteng uh ka daisakta hi.
english: A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam; attack! I have stopped all of Media’s sighing.

paite: Huaiziak in ka kawng natna thupitak in adim a, numei nauvei natna bang a natna in ahon manta; bil a za thei lou khop in na ka thuak a; kho mu thei lou khop in ka mangbang hi.
english: Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have taken hold on me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much pain that I can’t hear. I so am dismayed that I can’t see.

paite: Ka lungtang aha huaihuai a, thil mulkimhuaitak in ahon hihlau a; nitak ninem ka na ngaklah sek, kei a ding in linna ahong suakta.
english: My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.

paite: Dohkan abawlkhol ua, galvengmi avengsak ua, ne in adawn ua; miliante aw, thou unla, lum sathau nuh un.
english: They prepare the table. They set the watch. They eat. They drink. Rise up, you princes, oil the shield!

paite: Toupa'n ka kiang ah huchi in agen hi, "Kuan inla, galvengmi vengsak in, ama'n athil muh gen hen;
english: For the Lord said to me, “Go, set a watchman. Let him declare what he sees.

paite: Sepaih apawlte, sakol tungtuang akopkop a paite sabiltung pawlte, sangawngsau pawlte, amuh chiang in pilvangtak in angaikhe kilkel ding," chi in.
english: When he sees a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of camels, he shall listen diligently with great attentiveness.”

paite: Huan amah humpinelkai bang in akikou a, "TOUPA aw, sun in galven buk tung ah ka dingh a, zankhua in ka venna ah na hon omsak gige a;
english: He cried like a lion: “Lord, I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime, and every night I stay at my post.

paite: ngai in, hiai lai ah mihing pawl, sakol tungtuang akopkop a pai ahong uh," chi in. Amah mah in, "Babilon apukta, apukta, amilim bawltawmte tengteng uh lei ah hihzan in a-omta," chi in adawng hi.
english: Behold, here comes a troop of men, horsemen in pairs.” He answered, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the engraved images of her gods are broken to the ground.

paite: Aw ka buh vuaksa, ka phual a buh; sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian a kipan a ka zak na kiang ua pulak ka hi.
english: You are my threshing, and the grain of my floor!” That which I have heard from Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, I have declared to you.

paite: Dumah puakgik. Mi'n Seir tang a kipan in ahon sam ua, "Galvengpa zan bangchi ahita a? Galvengpa, zan bangchi ahita a?" chi in.
heading: Edom Tungtang Thugen
english: The burden of Dumah. One calls to me out of Seir, “Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?”

paite: Galvengpa'n, "Zingsang hi ding ahita, zan leng; na dot nop uleh dong un; kihei nawn unla, hong pai un,” achi hi.
english: The watchman said, “The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire. Come back again.”

paite: Arabia gam tung a puakgik. Dedante khualzin pawlchihte aw, Arabia gam a gamnuai ah na giak ding uh.
heading: Arabia Tungtang Thugen
english: The burden on Arabia. In the forest in Arabia you will lodge, you caravans of Dedanites.

paite: Dangtak kiang ah tui ahon tawi ding ua, Tema gam a omte'n a-an un taimangte ana dawn uhi.
english: They brought water to him who was thirsty. The inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread.

paite: Amau lah namsaute a kipan, namsau dohsa a kipan leh thalpeu laisa a kipan leh kidouna thupitak a kipan ataimang uhi.
english: For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow, and from the heat of battle.

paite: Toupa'n lah huchi in ka kiang ah achi ngal a, "Kilohmi kum sim a kum khat sung in Kedarte thupina tengteng amang khin ding hi.
english: For the Lord said to me, “Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail,

paite: Thalkapmi, Kedar suante lak a mihattak omsunte, tawmchik ahi ding uh; TOUPA Israel' Pathian in, huai agenta hi," chi in.
english: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, will be few; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, has spoken it.”
